title: Implement scraping client in Next.js (lib/scraping/client.ts)
description: Create a thin HTTP client in the Next.js app (src/lib/scraping/client.ts) that calls the Express sidecar API. This abstracts the HTTP calls from the pipeline and handles errors gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: `checkScraperHealth()` calls GET http://localhost:3001/api/health and returns boolean
If the scraper is not running, `crawlUrl` throws a descriptive error: 'Scraping server not running. Start it with npm run dev.'
Network errors are caught and re-thrown with helpful messages
Types are imported from `./types` (shared with the scraper)

steps.details: Copy or re-export the types from `src/scraper/types.ts` into `src/lib/scraping/types.ts`. These are the shared contract between the Express API and the Next.js app: `CrawlRequest`, `PageData`, `BrandingData`, `CrawlResult`.

technicalNotes: This client is only called from Next.js API routes (server-side) — never from client components.
The SCRAPER_URL env var allows changing the port if needed without code changes.
